item.body:
About us

Property Media Japan specialises in Real Estate Photography, Videography, Aerial Photography, Floor-plans and Virtual Staging. Previously based in Queenstown New Zealand, we are now operating in Niseko, Hokkaido Japan.

Discover serene luxury at 239 Franklin Road, nestled in the picturesque town of Queenstown. This contemporary 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home embodies a blend of modern elegance and the tranquil beauty of Queenstown. Constructed recently with high-quality finishes, it offers a spacious living room ideal for relaxation and entertaining, complemented by breathtaking mountain and lake views that frame every window. The kitchen is equipped with modern appliances, set against sleek cabinetry and a stylish brass-accented faucet.

Both bedrooms are designed with comfort in mind, with plush bedding and cozy decor, while large windows bring the outdoors in. The living room opens to a private balcony, perfect for enjoying Niseko’s natural beauty and crisp air. The bathroom and laundry area are thoughtfully planned, featuring a glass-enclosed shower, stacked washer and dryer, and a heated towel rack for convenience and luxury.

Outside, the unit includes a dedicated parking space with ski storage, catering to winter sports enthusiasts eager to explore the slopes nearby. The property is part of "The Point" luxury apartments, providing exclusive access to the area’s stunning landscapes and recreational activities.

Whether you’re looking for a peaceful retreat or a base for adventure, 239 Franklin Road is an ideal sanctuary, complete with modern comforts and a connection to nature’s finest.
